prompt: A savannah scene with a waterhole in the center. A herd of four elephants is drinking on the left side of the waterhole, while three zebras are drinking on the right side. The number of elephants is one more than the number of zebras. A lion is stalking a gazelle from behind a patch of tall grass; the lion is larger than the hyena. On a tall acacia tree to the right of the waterhole, a flock of birds is perched. The tree is taller than the elephants. The number of birds is twice the number of zebras. A hyena lurks behind a termite mound, which is taller than the hyena. A vulture circles in the sky above the lion and gazelle.
